measurementPolicy: Artwork is illustrative. Exact numbers, force arrows, scales, labels and interactive targets are controlled in app code. Apparatus scenes are not instructions to construct or wire real devices.

assets.title: Mechanical waterwheel and biomass-to-transport-fuel contexts

panels: Illustrated stream directly powers a wooden waterwheel and flour mill.
Illustrated crop and wood residues, processing facilities and vehicle fuelling.
assets.scientificNote: These are synthetic educational illustrations, not actual photographs, plant-process evidence or a claim that every wood feedstock becomes vehicle fuel. The waterwheel illustrates direct mechanical use; the facility and vehicle illustrate processing plant material into usable fuel. The correct placements come only from question data.

questionUsage.notes: Generated scene dimensions are not measurement evidence; exact readings, force arrows and scientific models remain controlled in code. Twelve original scene panels appear on draggable cards in three Energy questions without identical destination photos. Resource-flow branch management-07 has two original illustrated cards and two unillustrated text cards; a future pack will fill the missing scientifically accurate scenes. Two original illustrated panels (waterwheel and biomass-derived vehicle fuel) complete all four movable cards in management-07. Optimized AVIF sprite is stored in GitHub; full-resolution PNG originals are in the teacher source archive.
